chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from a number of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The believer's spending of the morning or the evening upon bereavement (thukl) is better for him than his spending a morning or an evening upon war (harab). So we seek Refuge with Allah from the war.'

key_terms.ثُكْل: Bereavement; loss of a loved one, specifically implying a deep, enduring grief.
key_terms.يُصْبِحُ: To spend the morning; to begin the day in a certain state.
key_terms.يُمْسِي: To spend the evening; to end the day in a certain state.

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of bereavement compared to war in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith contrasts the internal spiritual trial of bereavement (thukl) with the external chaos of war (harab), suggesting that the patience required for personal loss is a more refined state of faith than enduring the turmoil of conflict. This reflects the Shia emphasis on inner tranquility and the transformative power of grief as a means of drawing closer to God, distinguishing it from the destructive nature of worldly strife.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from a number of our companions,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> havings aid: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Spending of the morning or the evening of the Believer upon bereavement is better for him than his spending a morning or an evening upon war. So we<sup>asws</sup> seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from the war’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from A number of our people has narrated who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
A believer’s spending days and nights with suffering from the losses of his loved ones is better than his spending days and nights in the state of war. We seek protection with Allah against war.’”
